messages:
sam: FYI planning a short cross-AZ maintenance window tonight 01:45-02:30 UTC to push a NIC firmware micropatch and validate graceful node handoff. scope: 10 GPU hosts spread across az1/az2/az3 (cohorts of 2 per AZ). objective: reproduce asymmetric egress stalls and confirm auto-failover to secondary racks.

viv: do we have a strict ordering to avoid cross-region egress spikes?

sam: yesorder: az2 -> az1 -> az3. reason: az2 has most hot-pref workloads so we drain it first into warm racks in the same region, then proceed.

ali: capacity check? we should avoid bumping reserved customer traffic.

sam: validated with cluster-sim: ~16% spare CPU/GPU after we pause best-effort batch jobs. reserved/dedicated racks untouched. only intermittent/backfill pools affected.

morgan: cost impact estimate? shifting to warm racks may change billing qualifiers for a short period.

sam: estimated ~0.5% extra GPU-hours for the window. finance gave a thumbs-up. added numbers to runbook: https://go/runbooks/infra/egress-nic-patch-2026 (internal).

viv: can you paste the node ops commands and gates so SRE can audit?

sam: flow: `kubectl cordon $NODE` -> `kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180 --timeout=12m` -> `ssh $NODE sudo fwupd install nic_firmware_v1.2.3 && sudo reboot` -> post-boot `curl -s https://internal/seed-prefix -d '{"pool":"gpu"}'` -> wait for `cache.prefix.ready`. gate: 3m for prefix; if >3m on two nodes consecutively, pause window.

ali: 3m may be tight if cache eviction occurs. can we bump to 4m and gate on `cache.prefix.p95` < 120s?

sam: bump to 4m and gate on p95 < 120s. if exceeded twice we stop and rollback. agreed.

morgan: add tracing: capture `dmesg` and `nic stats` before and after. small traces only.

sam: added: `dmesg -T > /tmp/dmesg-$(hostname).log; ethtool -S eno1 > /tmp/nic-stats.log` compress and upload to s3 runbook bucket. keep each <8MB.

ops-bot: scheduled by sam: cross-az-egress-nic @ 2026-06-20T01:45:00Z -> 2026-06-20T02:30:00Z. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/infra/egress-nic-patch-2026. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

viv: I'll draft a support blurb: "Reserved customers unaffected. Intermittent pools may see brief scheduling delays as we validate NIC firmware; we'll monitor latency dashboards." post 30m prior.

ali: please also ask #support-ops to watch `egress.queue.depth` and `gpu.latency.p95`.

sam: done. ops-bot will emit start/finish messages.

morgan: who is executing? I can join for cohort 1.

sam: me + morgan exec, viv monitors dashboards, ali watches customer comms.

viv: small nitadd rollback step: if two nonconsecutive nodes fail warm-prefix gate, revert firmware via fwupd rollback and tag nodes for deeper diag.

sam: added rollback to runbook. final check: anyone object to start time? :alarm_clock:

ali: no objections. :thumbsup:

morgan: on standby.

sam: kicking cohort 1 in ~6m. leaving thread open for live notes.
